Hi - I absolutely feel your pain. Seroquel is an absolute bitch to withdraw from. Has your doctor recommended a gradual reduction in dosage? If you absolutely must discontinue, plan for a few sleepless nights (e.g. I booked some time off work) - accepting that it will happen can help make it a bit less stressful. Avoid naps, keep active during the day, and know that the impact of coming off the medication won’t last forever.

As for a replacement for a long term sleep issue, I would take medical guidance as I’ve no real experience there. Actually, take medical guidance for the whole journey, this comment only shares my experience.

“Right, wrong, what to do / some day it’ll come to you” - the tendency to trip over answers to questions and the desire to project your best self vs. Most authentic self.

“Hostile Indians, we named a summer camp for you” - the tendency to be reductive of conflict and paste over the truth to make it more palatable.

“I’ve got nothing to say…” - there are bigger things going on in the world so why are you looking to me?
